evidence_sources_in_PartII: IGO founding year in constitutive instrument or authoritative institutional history.
decision_memo: Included to capture institutional age and historical sequencing effects that shape organisational routines and path dependence.
boundary_notes: Use earliest formal establishment date; if reconstituted, record both original and reconstitution year in notes.

evidence_sources_in_PartII: Spatial scope statements in mandate (global, regional, specified areas) and any explicit geographic qualifiers.
decision_memo: Included to distinguish the geographic scope of mandates and to make spatial overlap visible when diagnosing regime complexity.
boundary_notes: Code as global unless mandate explicitly limits jurisdiction; record overlapping or nested spatial scopes in notes.

evidence_sources_in_PartII: Mandated issue areas and thematic remit in objectives and programme documents.
decision_memo: Included to separate governance mechanisms from the subject matter governed and to track issue-domain overlap across organisations.
boundary_notes: Use controlled issue vocabulary; multi-issue mandates can be multi-coded but should retain primary remit.

supporting_constructs: Secretariat authority and influence; Rule of Law; Norms and soft law; Legitimacy
evidence_sources_in_PartII: Constitutive treaty, UN resolution, charter provision, decision of COP/MOP, or other instrument establishing authority.
decision_memo: Included to capture the legal basis and authority source of an organisation, which conditions formal powers and procedural obligations.
boundary_notes: Classify by instrument type; when soft-law basis dominates, record the primary enabling decision and its status.

evidence_sources_in_PartII: Stated objectives in founding instruments, strategic plans, and core programme documents.
decision_memo: Included to operationalise stated purposes that guide organisational activity and enable cross-IGO comparison of mission orientation.
boundary_notes: Extract verbatim objective statements where available; code to controlled objective categories for comparability.

supporting_constructs: Policy integration and coherence; Accountability mechanisms; Transparency; Compliance and enforcement; MRV and evaluation; Conflict Resolution; Effectiveness; Learning, innovation and capacity building; Robustness and resilience
evidence_sources_in_PartII: Programme strategies, workplans, monitoring/evaluation systems, compliance tools, capacity-building activities.
decision_memo: Included to capture the main operational tools and governance instruments through which IGOs pursue objectives.
boundary_notes: Code only strategies evidenced in authoritative documents; avoid inferring strategies from secondary commentary alone.

supporting_constructs: Regime complex and fragmentation; Policy integration and coherence; Inter-agency coordination; Global Cooperation; Intermediaries; Secretariat authority and influence
evidence_sources_in_PartII: MoUs, joint programmes, coordination mechanisms, referencing of other organisations in mandates, intermediary arrangements.
decision_memo: Included to represent formal and informal relationships with other IGOs and institutions, including delegated or orchestrated arrangements.
boundary_notes: Record relationship type (coordination, delegation, orchestration, partnership) and directionality when stated.

supporting_constructs: Participation, engagement and representation; Equity and intergenerational equity
evidence_sources_in_PartII: Reporting obligations, national focal point arrangements, capacity-building channels, stakeholder consultation modalities.
decision_memo: Included to capture mechanisms linking global institutions to national and subnational actors and vertical flows of authority, reporting, or support.
boundary_notes: Code vertical links only when they are institutionalised (procedural rules, mandatory reporting, formal liaison structures).

supporting_constructs: Regime complex and fragmentation; Policy integration and coherence; Inter-agency coordination; Global Cooperation; Partnerships and public–private arrangements
evidence_sources_in_PartII: Inter-agency coordination bodies, joint workstreams, partnerships, network participation, cross-institutional harmonisation.
decision_memo: Included to capture lateral coordination among peers in regime complexes, including cross-issue and cross-sector organisational coupling.
boundary_notes: Differentiate horizontal coordination from vertical links; code only documented relationships or institutionalised coordination.
